result.summary: The image shows a commercial intersection equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment lacks physical buffers between pedestrians and traffic, and the roadway surface shows significant signs of degradation and patching.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the roadway surface near the pedestrian crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: No physical separation such as trees, bollards, or parked car buffers between the sidewalk and moving traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk edge adjacent to the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing faded transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the overall quality of the walking environment.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide roadway with multiple travel lanes and a complete lack of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. This design prioritizes vehicle throughput and creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated pedestrian crossing areas are marked at this large signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any refuge islands.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no visual indication of when it is safe to cross relative to the traffic signal cycles.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for walking. The large expanse of asphalt and lack of pedestrian refuge areas significantly increase exposure and risk for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians are visible, making it unclear when it is safe to cross relative to vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that indicate the remaining time to cross safely.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic signals, providing a baseline level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for an extended period without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection leg in the foreground.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
